description: Read the fort's server logs: access (nginx), error (nginx), php (PHP errors) or wp-cron (its systemd journal). Filters run on the worker: lines = last N matching lines (1-2000, default 200), grep = keep lines containing this text (case-insensitive literal, no regex), since = drop lines older than this ISO time with zone (stack-trace lines stay with their entry). A missing log is an error, not an empty answer. Secret URL parameters (token=, key=, pass=, ...) and credential shapes are masked. Needs BEARFORT_API_KEY (Bearfort fleet 2026-10-08.3+ for the filters).

grep.description: Keep only lines containing this text

since.description: Only lines at or after this time, e.g. 2026-10-08T12:00:00Z

site.description: Site id (see list_sites); must be hosted on Bearfort

name: fort_logs_read
